doc.title: step-serpent
doc.body: Sound effect only: One serpent slithering movement: dry scales and earth brushing under the body. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: step-flier
doc.body: Sound effect only: One flying creature movement: a compact flap of leathery wings through air. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-biped
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hostile biped creature gives one low guttural battle growl. No human words. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-quadruped
doc.body: Sound effect only: A wild four-legged beast gives one throaty growl with a short snarl, canine rather than feline. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-crawler
doc.body: Sound effect only: A large crawler gives one rasping hiss and chitter, close and unsettling. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-hopper
doc.body: Sound effect only: A hostile hopping creature gives one sharp throaty bark with a short trill. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: cry-slime
doc.body: Sound effect only: A gelatinous slime gives one wet burbling call and low wobbling squeak. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.
